run_train: run the QMC training loop with a ConfigDict to optimize a FermiNet wavefunction
init_electrons: initialize electron positions and spin configurations around atoms for MCMC sampling
make_opt_update_step: create an OptUpdate callable that evaluates loss and gradients and updates parameters using optax
make_training_step: create a training step callable that performs MCMC moves then an optimization update
make_kfac_training_step: create a KFAC training step callable that performs MCMC moves then a KFAC optimization update
